description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the AuditableInterceptor class in an OpenMRS Hibernate API context, specifically testing audit-related behavior on entity persistence and modification events.

classes.name: AuditableInterceptorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the AuditableInterceptor, testing audit-related intercept logic in Hibernate persistence lifecycle.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldReturnFalseForNonAuditableObjects
methods.description: Tests that the interceptor's onFlushDirty method returns false when called with an object that does not implement Auditable.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldSetTheChangedByField
methods.description: Tests that the onFlushDirty method sets the 'changedBy' property on an Auditable User object.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldSetTheDateChangedField
methods.description: Tests that the onFlushDirty method sets the 'dateChanged' property on an Auditable User object.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldAddPersonChangedByForPerson
methods.description: Tests that the interceptor adds 'personChangedBy' property during flush dirty operation for Person objects.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldAddPersonDateChangedForPerson
methods.description: Ensures that the 'personDateChanged' property is set during flush for Person objects.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldNotFailWithNullPreviousState
methods.description: Verifies that the method gracefully handles null previous state without failure.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldBeCalledWhenSavingAnAuditable
methods.description: Checks that the interceptor's onFlushDirty is invoked on saving an Auditable entity, leading to updates on 'dateChanged'.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldNotFailWhenTheDaemonUserModifiesSomething
methods.description: Ensures that the audit interceptor behaves correctly even when actions are performed by the system Daemon user.

methods.name: AsDaemonTask
methods.description: Inner class to run scheduled tasks as a Daemon to simulate system-level user modifications during tests.

methods.name: onSave_shouldReturnTrueIfDateCreatedWasNull
methods.description: Tests that onSave returns true when 'dateCreated' property is null, indicating the property was populated.

methods.name: onSave_shouldReturnTrueIfCreatorWasNull
methods.description: Verifies that onSave returns true when 'creator' property is null, prompting auto-population.

methods.name: onSave_shouldReturnFalseIfDateCreatedAndCreatorWasNotNull
methods.description: Checks that onSave returns false when both 'dateCreated' and 'creator' are already set, preventing overwriting.

methods.name: onSave_shouldBeCalledWhenSavingOpenmrsObject
methods.description: Ensures that the onSave interceptor is invoked when creating a new User object.

methods.name: onSave_shouldPopulateDateCreatedForPersonIfNull
methods.description: Tests that a Person's 'dateCreated' and 'personDateCreated' are set if null during save.

methods.name: onSave_shouldPopulateCreatorForPersonIfNull
methods.description: Checks that 'creator' and 'personCreator' are populated for Person if null.

methods.name: onSave_shouldPopulatePersonChangedByandPersonDateChangedIfPersonAlreadyExists
methods.description: Ensures that modification of existing Person entities updates 'personChangedBy' and 'personDateChanged'.

methods.name: createPersonWithNameAndAddress
methods.description: Helper method to create a Person with associated name and address for testing.
